models_evaluated: dynamic prediction model for 3-monthly flare risk in RA bDMARD tapering

links.outcome: Flare rate per patient over 18 months, prediction-aided vs disease activity-guided tapering, in randomised trial
links.effect: Mean flares 1.00 (95% CI 0.73-1.27) prediction-aided vs 0.73 (0.51-0.95) DGDO; rate ratio 1.32 (95% CI 0.90-1.95). Any flare 57% vs 44%; major flares 22% vs 15%.
links.quote: Prediction-aided bDMARD tapering using this model did not improve flare rates or medication use.

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomised controlled trial testing the real-world deployment and clinical impact of a dynamic prediction model used as clinical decision support for tapering biologics in rheumatoid arthritis.

primary.practice: AI-guided clinical decision support for drug tapering
